full_judgment: 4. In support of the petition Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record submits, inter alia, that the High Court Division committed error in passing the impugned judgment failing to consider that sanction of the appropriate Government is a pre-requisite for prosecution of the public servant like accused petitioner and that the High Court Division is wrong in saying that the proceeding of a case starts with framing of charge.
